```{r}
# eac_map_corrected.R
# -------------------
# Replacement for the Figure A chunk of the OISST version of the EAC Rmd,
# the one that reads oisst_annual_mean_seaus.csv. The temperature field,
# the Bass Strait box, the colour scale and the land polygon are unchanged.
# Only the current annotation is rebuilt.
#
# What changed, and why:
#
# 1. LINE WEIGHTS NOW MATCH THE PHYSICS. eac_main ran bold and solid from
#    22 S all the way to 40 S, while the eastward branch was the thinnest,
#    dotted line. That says most of the flow continues to Tasmania, which is
#    backwards. At separation the bulk of the transport turns east as the
#    Tasman Front; what goes south is the remainder. So eac_main now stops at
#    the separation latitude, the eastward branch inherits the bold solid line
#    and the arrowhead, and the southward extension is thin and dashed.
#
# 2. ONE SOUTHWARD PATH, NOT TWO. The original drew a solid arrow ending near
#    40 S AND a dashed arrow curving to 43.5 S. They look like two different
#    phenomena. Only the extension remains.
#
# 3. THE SEPARATION LABEL HAS SOMETHING TO POINT AT. It sat at 36.5 S with
#    nothing happening at the latitude it names. There is now a marker at the
#    branch point and the label sits beside it.
#
# 4. THE EXTENSION IS DRAWN AS EDDIES. It does not travel south as a jet. The
#    open circles along the dashed path say so without a word, and they set up
#    the argument that heat arrives in pulses rather than as steady warming.
#
# One thing to check that is not about the drawing. The figure caption says the
# EAC region warms at three to four times the global average and cites Holbrook
# & Bindoff (1997) and Suthers et al. (2011). Holbrook & Bindoff is about
# interannual and decadal variability in the southwest Pacific, not that rate.
# The paper usually cited for the Tasman Sea warming rate is Ridgway (2007),
# Geophysical Research Letters 34, L13613. Worth swapping or adding.



library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

sst_mean <- read.csv("oisst_annual_mean_seaus.csv")

aus <- ne_countries(country = "Australia", scale = "medium",
                    returnclass = "sf")

# ---- current pathway ------------------------------------------------------
SEP_LON <- 153.0
SEP_LAT <- -34.0

# the EAC proper: ends where it leaves the coast
eac_main <- data.frame(
  lon = c(151.0, 153.5, 154.5, 155.0, 154.5, 154.0, SEP_LON),
  lat = c(-22.0, -24.0, -26.0, -28.0, -30.0, -32.0, SEP_LAT)
)

# the Tasman Front: most of the transport, so this keeps the bold line
tasman_front <- data.frame(
  lon = c(SEP_LON, 154.5, 156.0, 157.6),
  lat = c(SEP_LAT, -34.5, -35.0, -35.6)
)

# the extension: the remainder, eddy-driven, reaching Tasmania
eac_extension <- data.frame(
  lon = c(SEP_LON, 152.5, 151.5, 151.0, 150.5, 149.5, 149.0),
  lat = c(SEP_LAT, -36.0, -38.0, -40.0, -41.0, -42.0, -43.5)
)

# a few eddies along it, so it does not read as a jet
eddies <- eac_extension[c(2, 3, 4, 6), ]
eddies$r <- c(2.6, 2.4, 2.2, 2.0)

p_sst <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = sst_mean, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = sst),
              interpolate = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = c("#053061", "#2166ac", "#4393c3", "#92c5de",
                 "#fddbc7", "#f4a582", "#d6604d", "#b2182b", "#67001f"),
    name     = "Mean annual\nSST (°C)",
    na.value = "white", limits = c(11, 27), breaks = seq(12, 26, 4)
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = aus, fill = "#d4c5a9", colour = "#8a7560",
          linewidth = 0.4) +

  # the current, bold to the separation point, no arrowhead yet
  geom_path(data = eac_main, aes(lon, lat), colour = "white",
            linewidth = 1.4, lineend = "round", linejoin = "round") +

  # the Tasman Front keeps the bold line and takes the arrowhead
  geom_path(data = tasman_front, aes(lon, lat), colour = "white",
            linewidth = 1.4, lineend = "round", linejoin = "round",
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed")) +

  # the extension, thin and dashed, with an open arrowhead
  geom_path(data = eac_extension, aes(lon, lat), colour = "white",
            linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "22", lineend = "round",
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "open")) +
  geom_point(data = eddies, aes(lon, lat, size = r), shape = 21,
             colour = "white", fill = NA, stroke = 0.7,
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3.0, 4.4)) +

  # the separation now has a marker under its label
  geom_point(aes(x = SEP_LON, y = SEP_LAT), shape = 21, size = 2.2,
             colour = "white", fill = "white", stroke = 0.6) +

  # Bass Strait box, unchanged
  annotate("rect", xmin = 143.5, xmax = 150.5, ymin = -40.5, ymax = -38.5,
           fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6,
           linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 146.5, y = -38.7, label = "Bass Strait",
           colour = "white", size = 2.6, fontface = "italic") +

  annotate("text", x = 150.5, y = -21, label = "East Australian\nCurrent (EAC)",
           colour = "white", size = 3.0, fontface = "bold",
           lineheight = 0.85, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 153.6, y = -32.4,
           label = "separates ~34°S;\nmost flow turns east",
           colour = "white", size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
           lineheight = 0.85, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 151.6, y = -40.4,
           label = "EAC Extension:\nwarm, nutrient-poor\neddies",
           colour = "white", size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
           lineheight = 0.85, hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 145.0, y = -42.3, label = "Tasmania",
           colour = "grey20", size = 3.5, fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 142.5, y = -37.5, label = "Victoria",
           colour = "grey20", size = 3.0, fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 139.5, y = -34.5, label = "South\nAustralia",
           colour = "grey20", size = 2.8, fontface = "italic",
           lineheight = 0.85) +

  coord_sf(xlim = c(138, 158), ylim = c(-45, -20), expand = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(140, 158, 4),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "°E"),
                     name = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-44, -20, 4),
                     labels = function(y) paste0(abs(y), "°S"),
                     name = "Latitude") +
  labs(caption = paste0("Source: NOAA OISST V2.1 annual mean (2015).\n",
                        "EAC pathway schematic based on Suthers et al. (2011) ",
                        "and Holbrook & Bindoff (1997).")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.caption      = element_text(size = 7, colour = "#888888", hjust = 0),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#cde8f0", colour = NA),
    panel.grid        = element_line(colour = "#b0cfd8", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    plot.margin       = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

ggsave("kelp_EAC_SST_map.png", p_sst, width = 6, height = 8,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")


```
